subject: kitchen dishwasher
title: What If You Never Cleaned Your Dishwasher?

scenes.text: What if you never cleaned your dishwasher? It washes your plates. Nothing washes it.
Within weeks, food scraps pile up in the filter. Consumer testers say to clean it once or twice a month.
The trapped food starts to rot and smell, water stops draining, and old bits land back on clean plates.
Meanwhile, the rubber door seal gets colonised. In 189 dishwashers on six continents, 62 percent had fungi.
Many were black yeasts that survive 60 to 80 degree washes, strong salt and harsh detergent.
The hottest, harshest machine in your kitchen turns out to be a perfect home, just for the wrong guest.

description:
What if you never cleaned your dishwasher? A clogged filter leaves food to rot, stops water draining and puts debris back on your dishes.
In a study of 189 home dishwashers on six continents, 62% had fungi on the rubber door seal, many of them black yeasts that tolerate hot, salty, soapy washes.
